\# Expands Reserve Plan listing access and adds filters

\## What’s new

Direct accounts and connected accounts with API access can now \[List Reserve Plans\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview).

You can now optionally use the \[destination\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#list\_reserve\_plans-destination) and \[status\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#list\_reserve\_plans-status) filter parameters when you \[List Reserve Plans\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview).

For changes to destination properties and Reserve Plan enum values, see the \[2026-09-30.endive GA changelog\](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/settlement-reserve-api.md).

\## Why is this a breaking change?

Previously, \[Listing Reserve Plans\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview) only returned risk reserve plans. It now returns plans across all destinations when the \[destination\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#list\_reserve\_plans-destination) parameter isn’t set. Integrations that assume all returned plans are risk reserves must account for the broader results or filter by destination.

\## Impact

When upgrading, set the \[destination\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview#list\_reserve\_plans-destination) parameter to \`risk\_reserved\` if your integration expects only risk reserve plans when \[Listing Reserve Plans\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/reserve/plan/list.md?api-version=2026-09-30.preview).

1\. \[View your current API version\](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2\. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
 \- If you don’t use an SDK, update your \[API requests\](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include \`Stripe-Version: 2026-09-30.preview\`
3\. Upgrade the API version used for \[webhook endpoints\](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4\. \[Test your integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5\. If you use Connect, \[test your Connect integration\](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about \[Stripe API upgrades\](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
